title: Testing route-level authorization with real middleware via webtest.Server
answers: How do I write a test that exercises actual route registration and the authorization middleware, not just the handler?
How to test single-org vs multi-org permission behavior for an API route?
body: Use SetupAPITestServer(t, func(hs *HTTPServer) {...}) to build a full webtest.Server with real route registration + auth middleware, then drive requests with server.NewRequest(method, path, body) wrapped in webtest.RequestWithSignedInUser(req, user.SignedInUser{...}). To simulate the authn layer supplying per-org permission snapshots, set hs.authnService to authntest.FakeService with Identity.Permissions keyed by org ID (accesscontrol.GlobalOrgID for global), and set hs.Cfg.RBAC.SingleOrganization to toggle single/multi-org mode. Stub out downstream dependencies (userService, starService, orgService, preferenceService, TeamService, authInfoService, AuthTokenService, accesscontrolService) with the *test fakes so the handler itself doesn't fail for unrelated reasons.
applies: HTTP-level authorization tests for pkg/api routes using RouteRegister + authorizeInOrg middleware
